strategies.name: Daily-Checkpoint Oversold-Bounce with Trend-Midpoint Exits (Mag10 + index ETFs)
strategies.original_market: US large-caps (AAPL MSFT GOOGL AMZN META NVDA TSLA AVGO AMD ORCL) + SPY/IWM/DIA
strategies.indicators: RSI(14), 20-day SMA, 50-day high, 20-day average volume
strategies.overview: Oversold-bounce on a fixed 13-name liquid universe, checked daily: buy on RSI(14)<30 below the 20-MA or a >=4% capitulation day on 1.5x volume, prefer the name furthest below its 50-day high; exit at the 20-MA touch, -5% stop, or 10-day time stop. Clean, complete, daily-bar retail mean-reversion spec with honest warnings about retail overtrading.
strategies.criteria: Fixed universe: 10 mega-caps + SPY/IWM/DIA only.
strategies.avoid_and_failure: Author's own caveat: retail active trading underperforms; RSI(14)<30 is a weak oversold trigger vs RSI(2) family; quarterly kill-switch review.
strategies.entry: RSI(14)<30 AND close<20-day SMA; OR close >=4% below prior close with volume >1.5x 20d avg. Tiebreak: largest drop from 50-day high.
strategies.exit: First of: close >=20-day SMA (TP), close >=5% below entry (SL), or 10 sessions held.
strategies.trade_management: $100 per trade at starter size; one position per signal; daily checkpoint.
strategies.target: Mean reversion to the 20-day SMA.
strategies.risk: 5% stop, 10-day time stop, fixed universe, quarterly strategy kill-switch.
strategies.best_timeframes: Daily bars (native).

strategies.name: Bollinger(30,2) Band-Touch Mean Reversion with Neutral Zone (EUR/USD)
strategies.indicators: SMA30 +/- 2 std Bollinger bands
strategies.overview: Band-touch mean reversion that stays FLAT between the bands: long only below the lower band, short only above the upper band, neutral otherwise. The neutral zone is the point of the strategy - fewer, higher-conviction trades and materially lower transaction costs than always-in-market signals; the notebooks show it outperforming buy-and-hold with less risk after costs.
strategies.criteria: Demonstrated on EUR/USD 6h; any liquid instrument.
strategies.avoid_and_failure: Band-riding trends (breakout days) produce consecutive losing fades; flat zones reduce trade count - few signals in quiet markets.
strategies.entry: Long when close < lower band (SMA30 - 2std); short when close > upper band; flat between bands.
strategies.exit: Re-enter neutral zone => flat (position = sign relative to bands).
strategies.trade_management: +1/-1/0 unit positions; proportional transaction cost modeled.
strategies.target: Reversion inside the band envelope.
strategies.risk: No stop beyond the flat-on-reentry rule; sustained trend = continuous adverse position.
strategies.best_timeframes: 6h bars in code; daily adaptation = classic Bollinger-band MR (cf. S011).
strategies.reported_metrics: Notebook claims outperformance vs buy-and-hold with lower risk after costs on EUR/USD sample (repo-claimed, unverified).
strategies.priority_rationale: The neutral-zone cost-efficiency insight is real and directly transferable to daily-bar S011 variants.

strategies.name: Prop-Firm MA-Gap Mean Reversion with Vol-Compression Gate (M5/M15/M30)
strategies.indicators: EMA360 fast MA, EMA20, RSI(20), fast/slow ATR, min_ma_gap % deviation, volume-weighted spread
strategies.overview: Fades large deviations from a slow EMA, but ONLY in compressed volatility: buy requires close < EMA360 - min_ma_gap% AND fast ATR < slow ATR AND RSI(20) still declining below the upper bound (entering early in the deviation, not after reversal). Sell mirror. Wrapped in serious prop-firm risk machinery: fixed $ risk, 1:5 RR, daily loss cap 5%, max DD 10%, multi-stage ATR trailing + profit-lock, order expiration, session rules.
strategies.criteria: 12 majors + XAUUSD/USOIL/XAGUSD (commodity-specific trailing per symbol); spread filter required.
strategies.avoid_and_failure: Deviation trades keep fading into trends - the ATR-compression gate helps but whipsaws remain; commodity trailing differs per symbol (curve-fit surface).
strategies.entry: Buy: close < EMA360 - gap AND atr_fast < atr_slow AND rsi[t-1] > rsi[t] AND rsi < rsi_upper(70). Sell mirror with rsi > rsi_lower(30). Up to MAX_TRADES_PER_SYMBOL_TF concurrent.
strategies.exit: Multi-stage trailing: profit_units-based ratchet + ATR-factor trailing; TP derived as entry +/- SL_distance * RISK_REWARD_RATIO(5); order expiration.
strategies.trade_management: $50 fixed risk per trade, position size = risk/SL; daily loss limit 5% equity; max DD 10% kill; session window Sun-Fri Lagos GMT+1.
strategies.target: 1:5 risk-reward take-profit.
strategies.risk: Fixed-dollar risk sizing, equity daily-loss and max-DD circuit breakers, spread monitoring.
strategies.best_timeframes: M5-M30 native; a daily adaptation (deviation from EMA200 in vol-compression) is testable but unproven.
strategies.priority_rationale: Interesting structural idea (deviation entry gated on vol compression) + genuinely complete risk framework; intraday-native.
strategies.notes: Entry buys into a STILL-FALLING deviation (rsi declining) - early-entry mean reversion, unusual.

strategies.name: Crypto Spot Z-Score Mean-Reversion + Rolling-Momentum Signal Blend
strategies.indicators: Rolling z-score of price; rolling sum of pct returns (momentum); sign-vote signal combiner
strategies.overview: Combines a rolling z-score mean-reversion signal (-zscore) and a rolling momentum signal on BTC/ETH daily prices, then takes the sign of the average as position. Blends two offsetting signals - mean reversion dominates unless momentum is extreme. Educational but directly testable.
strategies.criteria: not specified in source. Suggested: liquid large-cap crypto (BTC, ETH).
strategies.avoid_and_failure: not specified in source. Suggested: avoid illiquid alts and stable pairs; blended signal neutralizes conflicting regimes - expect few clean trades in choppy tape.
strategies.entry: Position = sign( mean( -zscore(close, window), rolling_sum(pct_change, window) ) ). Window not specified in source. Suggested: window=20.
strategies.exit: Position flips when combined signal crosses zero; effectively always-in-market long/flat.
strategies.trade_management: not specified in source. Suggested: 1 unit per asset; transaction_cost deducted per position change in backtest_portfolio.
strategies.target: not specified in source. Suggested: hold until signal sign change.
strategies.risk: Backtest deducts transaction_cost * |position diff|; separate Sharpe-max long-only portfolio optimizer over the two assets. Suggested: cap per-asset weight 100%.
strategies.best_timeframes: Daily bars (returns pct_change daily).
strategies.priority_rationale: Naive signal blend on 2 assets; weak expected edge, but daily-native and testable.
strategies.notes: optimize_portfolio is Sharpe-max long-only over the two cryptos, separate from the signal blend.

strategies.trade_management: Single long leg at a time, swaps daily; no short leg.
strategies.target: Reconvergence of the decorrelated pair / loser catching up.

strategies.name: Quadratic Dip-Depth Sizing Formula on VTI/QQQ (SGOV cash park)
strategies.indicators: 50-day high distance (dip%) on daily closes

strategies.risk: No stop-loss by design; concentration in 2 correlated ETFs.
